items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.

Complete maintenance tool 
 set.

Cleaning fluid, Manual 
 puller.

Feeler gauge, Dial 
 indicator.

Vibrometer, Straight 
 edge.
Rags.

Check discharge quantity 
 and pressure and record them.

Check the vibration level 
 of the pump set complete with the motor then, record them.

Check alignment and 
 record it.

Dismantle all attached 
 pipes to the pump.

Unscrew motor bolts and 
 take it out.

Lift pump from its place 
 to the work place.

Dismantle the gland of 
 the pump and remove packing cords out.

Dismantle the pump half 
 coupling.

Dismount thrust bearing 
 complete with the hanger.

Dismantle discharge elbow 
 and shaft guide pipes.

Dismantle the shaft 
 joints by unscrewing them from their mafe couplings.

Dismantle suction lantern 
 if used, then take suction slide bearing out.

Begin dismantling the 
 hydraulic part from suction.

Dismantle impellers, 
 sleeves and diffusers from the hydraulic part shaft after dismantling the pump 
 clamping bolts.

Check all dismantled 
 parts for worn-out and replace by new one (if it is needed).

The validity of the 
 anti-friction ball bearings.

Check all parts for any 
 worn-out and replace them by new ones.

Inspect the run-out of 
 shafts (allowance 0.03 mm).

Begin the assembly from 
 the hydraulic part first.

Install diffusers, 
 sleeves, and impellers from the discharge side up to suction side and tight 
 them with the clamping bolts.

Insert shaft in the 
 suction slide bearing with lantern and check radial and axial clearance of the 
 pump and ensure that pump rotate easily, otherwise dismount and treat the 
 causes.

Install the shaft joints 
 with their mafe couplings

Mount the shaft guide 
 pipes.

Install the hanger 
 complete with discharge elbow into shaft guide pipes.

Mount the stuffing box 
 with gland.

Mount the thrust bearing 
 and cover it.

Install the pump half 
 coupling.

Lift the pump by crane 
 and put it in its place.

Fix the pump and tight 
 all attached pipes.

Mount the electric motor 
 and adjust alignment.

Install packing cords and 
 tight gland bolts easily.

Do not forget to grease 
 thrust bearing.

Check the direction of 
 rotation of pump before starting the pump for the first time.

Check the quantity of 
 grease in the thrust-bearing sump.

Check whether the inlet 
 for flooding the stuffing box is open.

Check whether the inlet 
 for hydraulic sealing of the suspension is open.

Check whether the 
 delivery sluice valve is closed.

Open the delivery valve 
 gradually after the set has been started to operate at its full speed.

The temperature of the 
 anti-friction bearing in the bearing top which should not exceed 75C.

The temperature of 
 cooling water at discharge.
